So we keep it simple: we only discuss rentals by text or call at +12348046729, and nowhere else. If someone messages you about one of our homes from a different number, a different page, or asks you to move the conversation somewhere else — it isn't us. Close it and text the real number.

Homes we've posted — with full addresses

These are real homes from our Canada Facebook posts, each shown with its full address, its own bedrooms, bathrooms and price, and a mix of inside photos — kitchen, living room, bedroom and bathroom together on every home, never just one picture, and never an outside photo. Pictures are mixed and spaced out across homes: the same picture never follows another home's same picture, and a picture only comes back after at least 24 other pictures — and several other photos of the same room — have been shown in between, so neighbouring homes never share a picture and never look the same. Tap the small labelled photos on any home to see each room bigger. A 1-bedroom home is listed as exactly that — 1 bed, 1 bath, with its kitchen and living room shown — and the same goes for every size. The 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom homes now show the new inside photos sent in for them — kitchen, bathroom, living room and bedroom — and only those new photos are used for 1 bed, 1 bath homes. Every home below also carries its own written description, of the home itself and of the area it is in. Prices follow one simple rule, set by each home’s location: homes in student areas near a university or college carry the low prices — C$400, C$500, C$600, C$700 or C$800 — and every other home is C$700, C$800, C$1,000, C$1,500 or C$2,000, varied by size. Use the search bar at the top to search for anything — type a city like Toronto, a neighbourhood, a street, a postal code like M5V, bedrooms or a price and every matching home pulls up here. Or pick your location where you're looking and this list filters to that city — pick your perfect one, and tap Text about this home on it. More homes, in more cities across Canada, go up on our Facebook Page every day — and every Canada home from both our Facebook Pages is listed in full just below.

How many pictures can a home have on this website?

There is no fixed limit. A home can show its main photo plus more photos right on its listing — tap the small photos on any listing above to see them — and its photos can also appear in the “A look inside” gallery. So send as many good pictures as you have for a house, and they can all go up; any time you send new pictures or a new location, they get added here too. One rule: pictures must be clean — no watermark, no name, no logo and no writing on the picture. Pictures with anything written on them are never used, so the website always looks clean and real.
